_comment: NET-NEW wire shape (supervisor-silent-listen, design D6/D12). POST /api/v1/supervisor/conversations/{conversationId}/listen/stop (no request body) ends the CALLER's own active listen on that conversation: the supervisor's leg is hung up and the agent's call is untouched. 200 with this body; endReason is always `stopped` here (the other end reasons, `call-ended` and `not-answered`, appear only in the audit trail, design D10). 404 listen-not-found when the caller has no active listen on that conversation; the other refusals are in fixtures/supervisor-listen-refusals.json. Every child change's delta spec must cite these field names VERBATIM (verbatim-fixture-citation rule, /xr:propagate).
